capabilities.name: V3 compiler and manifest dispatch
capabilities.requirement: compile V3 source-episode tasks from the frozen dry manifests without touching the V2 compiler path; the V3 split label must come from the manifest, never inferred from the generator-namespace layout_id

capabilities.name: replica-level Target-V4 outcome preservation
capabilities.requirement: persist every per-replica Y_r, disposition, termination and failed-predicate set; V2 discarded these and the gate-7 forensics had to replay to recover them

capabilities.name: (k, R) aggregation
capabilities.requirement: compute k as the sum of per-replica Y_r and bind R from the frozen replica protocol, not from the observed record count

capabilities.name: V3 candidate supervision record
capabilities.requirement: emit the canonical supervision payload defined in the row-binding contract, stored alongside and never inside any outcome-independent identity

capabilities.name: V3 row identity
capabilities.requirement: implement rvt-recoverability-row-identity/v3 with exactly the sixteen declared fields and a fail-closed check against the prohibited list

capabilities.name: V3 dataset writer
capabilities.requirement: write to a V3-only namespace with its own manifest and seal; must refuse to write into any V2 path

capabilities.name: V3 dataset loader contract
capabilities.requirement: group by decision event, require both candidates, require exactly N robot rows per candidate, expose (k, R) per candidate, enforce the split boundary, refuse V2-schema rows, and shuffle event groups deterministically

capabilities.name: event-equal grouped Bernoulli loss interface
capabilities.requirement: implement the frozen loss with the mandatory 1/R normalization and a numerically stable formulation from logits

capabilities.name: event-equal Brier evaluator
capabilities.requirement: implement the frozen Brier aggregation order; a raw row mean must be impossible to express through the interface
